n-k-l1f-03.title: Machungwa matatu, mutengo wakanaka here?
n-k-l1f-03.goal: Edza chirevo chemutengi nechiratidzo chemutengo, patsanura mutengo wechinhu chimwe nehuwandu hwose, uye upe zano nenhamba.
n-k-l1f-03.material:
Pachitoro chemichero, Jisu neshamwari yake Minsu vanoverenga chiratidzo:

[귤]
한 개: 1,000원
세 개: 2,500원

Jisu: 저는 귤 두 개만 필요해요.
Minsu: 세 개에 이천오백 원이에요! 싸요! 세 개 사요!
n-k-l1f-03.thinking.1: Mutengo wechinhu chimwe vs mutengo wose
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chiratidzo. Chirevo chipi chinotsigirwa nechiratidzo?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa mutengo wemachungwa matatu ega nemutengo wepaketi remachungwa matatu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.1: Wobva waenzanisa huwandu hwose hwehuwandu hwemachungwa hwakafanana.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.a: Machungwa matatu anodhura zvishoma kupfuura machungwa maviri.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.a: Machungwa 3 anodhura 2,500 won; machungwa 2 anodhura 2,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.b: Machungwa maviri kubva pamutengo wega anodhura kupfuura paketi retatu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.b: 2 x 1,000 = 2,000 won, iri pasi pe 2,500 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.c: Jungwa rimwe nerimwe mupaketi retatu rinodhura zvishoma kupfuura jungwa rimwe rega.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.d: Paketi retatu rinodhura zvakaenzana nemachungwa matatu ega.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.d: Machungwa 3 ega anodhura 3,000 won, kwete 2,500 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.explain: Paketi rinodhura 2,500 won kumatatu, anenge 833 won rimwe nerimwe, uku jungwa rimwe rega rinodhura 1,000 won. Saka jungwa rimwe nerimwe rinodhura zvishoma mupaketi, asi paketi rinodhura zvakawanda kupfuura maviri ega muhuwandu hwose.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.prompt: Jisu anoda machungwa maviri chete mangwana. Zano raMinsu '세 개 사요, 싸요!' rakanaka here kuchikwama chake?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti Jisu anoda machungwa mangani, wobva wawana mutengo wehuwandu iroro chaiwo nenzira imwe neimwe.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bvunza kuti 'cheap' mumutsara waMinsu inoreva paungwa rimwe kana muhuwandu hwose.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.a: Hongu. Jungwa rimwe nerimwe rinodhura zvishoma mupaketi, saka paketi rinodhura zvishoma kwaari.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.a: Kudhura zvishoma pajungwa rimwe hazvirevi kudhura zvishoma muhuwandu hwose. Aizobhadhara 2,500 won, kwete 2,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.b: Kwete. Maviri ega anodhura 2,000 won, uye paketi rinodhura zvakawanda.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.c: 3,000 won mutengo wemachungwa matatu ega, asi anoda machungwa maviri chete.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.d: Hazvigoni kusarudzwa nokuti chiratidzo hachina mutengo wemachungwa maviri.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.d: Maviri ega anodhura 2 x 1,000 = 2,000 won; chiratidzo chinopa zvakakwana.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.explain: Kumachungwa maviri, maviri ega (2,000 won) anodhura zvishoma kupfuura paketi (2,500 won). Chirevo chaMinsu chechokwadi pajungwa rimwe, asi hachikodzeri zvaunoda Jisu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zano remitsara 1-2 kuna Jisu (chiRungu kana chiKorea). Shandisa nhamba dzechiratidzo sehumbowo.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.0: Taura zvaunoda Jisu, wobva wapa huwandu hwose hwenzira imwe neimwe yekutenga.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.1: Pedzisa nekutaura nzira ipi inodhura zvishoma kwaari.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndinopa nhamba mbiri, kwete 'inodhura zvishoma' chete here?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Zano rangu rinokodzera kuti Jisu anoda machungwa maviri here?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.model.1: Kumachungwa maviri, tenga maviri ega: 2,000 won. Paketi retatu ndi 2,500 won, saka rinodhura zvakawanda kunyange jungwa rimwe nerimwe richidhura zvishoma.

n-k-l1e-01.title: Zita, basa ... uye nyika?
n-k-l1e-01.goal: Cherekedza kuti makadhi maviri ekuzvizivisa haana chokwadi chinobvunzwa nemubvunzo, sarudza chii chichiri chisipo, uye ubvunze nezvacho muKorea.
n-k-l1e-01.material:
Zuva rekutanga rekirasi. Mudzidzisi wako anogovera makadhi maviri ekuzvizivisa (akagadzirwa pabasa iri).

[카드 1]
안녕하세요? 저는 수진이에요. 학생이에요.

[카드 2]
안녕하세요? 저는 마이클이에요. 선생님이에요.

Mudzidzisi anoratidza kadhi 1 uye anobvunza: "수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?"
n-k-l1e-01.prereq.1: Unoziva 이름, 학생, 선생님, 사람 nemazita enyika
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.prompt: Mudzidzisi wako anobvunza: '수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?' Uchishandisa makadhi maviri bedzi, mhinduro yakanakisa i ipi?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Rondedza zvinotaurwa nemutsara mumwe nemumwe pakadhi 1: zita, basa ... chimwe chinhu here?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Zvibvunze kana makadhi aine izwi renyika kana '-사람'.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.a: Hongu. 수진 i zita reKorea, saka anobva kuKorea.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.a: Zita i chiratidzo, kwete humbowo: vanhu venyika dzakawanda vane mazita eKorea, uye vanhu veKorea vane mamwe mazita. Tsvaga mutsara unotaura nyika.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.b: Kwete. 학생 zvinoreva kuti anodzidza kunze, saka haasi weKorea.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.c: Hazvisati. Makadhi anopa zita rake nebasa, asi hakuna nyika.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.d: Hazvisati. Kadhi 1 haina zita, saka hapana anogona kutaura.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.d: Zita riri pakadhi: 수진. Chikamu chisipo i chimwe.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.explain: Kadhi 1 inopa zita (수진) nebasa (학생) asi haitaure nyika. Kadhi 2 haribatsiri: i rezve 마이클. Mhinduro i 'haisati yaziikanwa', uye unoda chokwadi chimwe chimwe.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira 수진 anowedzera mutsara MUMWE pakadhi rake. Mitsara ipi yakawedzerwa yaizogadzirisa mubvunzo wemudzidzisi? Sarudza yose inogadzirisa (hongu kana kwete zvose zvinoverengwa).
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga mitsara inotaura nyika yemunhu, kwete hobby kana kudzidza.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Edza mutsara mumwe nemumwe: mushure mekuuverenga, unogona kutaura 'hongu' kana 'kwete' wakasimba here?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.r.a: Vanhu vazhinji venyika dzakawanda vanodzidza Korea, saka izvi hazvitaure nyika yake.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.explain: Mutsara une '-사람이에요' unotaura nyika. 호주 사람 inopindura 'kwete', 한국 사람 inopindura 'hongu'. Kudzidza Korea kana kufarira kofi hazvisarudzi.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mubvunzo wako kuna 수진 muKorea (kutaura kunoremekedza -요) kuti uwane chokwadi chisipo.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti chokwadi chipi chisipo, wobva wabvunza nezvacho bedzi.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mubvunzo wangu unobvunza chokwadi chisipo (nyika) here, kwete chaitotaurwa nemakadhi?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unoremekedza (-요) uye wakapfupika zvakakwana kupindurwa nemutsara mumwe here?

n-k-l1e-02.title: Tag yaRina nemazwi aRina
n-k-l1e-02.goal: Tarisa kuzvizivisa kwakataurwa nenzwi nenzwi netag yezita, tsvaga mutsara mumwe une chokwadi chisina kururama, utaure rudzi rwekukanganisa, uye ugadzirise.
n-k-l1e-02.material:
Rina i muenzi. Akapfeka tag yezita uye anozvizivisa kuklasi.

[이름표]
이름: 리나
나라: 일본
직업: 선생님

Anotaura mitsara mishanu iri pazasi.
n-k-l1e-02.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa kukanganisa kwegirama nechokwadi chisina kururama
n-k-l1e-02.prereq.1: Unoziva 선생님, 학생, 일본 사람 ne -이에요/예요
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.prompt: Rina anoverenga kuzvizivisa kwake nenzwi. Enzanisa netag yezita rake. Mutsara mumwe chete haienderani netag. Mutsara upi?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.0: Mimwe mitsara i kukwazisa uye haina ruzivo. Ratidza mitsara ine ruzivo.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tora tag chokwadi nechokwadi (zita, nyika, basa) wobva watsvaga mutsara unotaura chimwe nechimwe.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 4 unoti 학생이에요 ('ndiri mudzidzi'), asi tag inoti 선생님 (mudzidzisi). Korea mumutsara 4 yakanaka mugirama; chokwadi hachina kururama. Mitsara 2 ne 3 inoenderana netag, uye mitsara 1 ne 5 i kukwazisa isina ruzivo.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.prompt: Mutsara waunosarudza i kukanganisa kwerudzi rupi?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga mutsara nenzwi segirama bedzi: unoputsa mutemo upi here?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Wobva waenzanisa zvinoreva, kwete chimiro, netag.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.a: Kupera -이에요 kwakarurama mushure mechikamu chine ravara rekupedzisira (생). Mutsara wakarurama mugirama.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.o.b: Girama yakanaka, asi chokwadi hachienderani netag yezita.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.d: 저는 i izwi rinoremekedza re 'ini' uye rakakodzera kusangana kwekutanga; 나는 raizova rakajairika.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.explain: Mutsara unogona kuva Korea yakarurama asi uchiri wakaipa kumamiriro ezvinhu. Pano mutsara wakanaka, asi hauenderani netag.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva mutsara usina kururama muKorea kuti uenderane netag yezita. Chengeta kutaura kunoremekedza -요.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.0: Isa izwi rebasa rakarurama kubva patag mupateni yemutsara imwechete.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kupera: izwi rebasa rinopera neravara rekupedzisira kana nzvovera?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wangu unoti basa riri patag here?

n-k-l1e-03.title: Izwi rimwe, mamiriro matatu
n-k-l1e-03.goal: Verenga izwi rimwechete reKorean mumamiriro matatu anokura, vandudza zvaraireva mamiriro achichinja, taura zvakasarudza, uye urishandise zvakarurama iwe pachako.
n-k-l1e-03.material: Mamiriro matatu mapfupi pakati peshamwari dzekirasi 하나 ne민수 (akagadzirwa). Vanoshandisa kutaura kwe -요 kune hunhu. Mamiriro ega ega anoratidzwa rimwe panguva.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.prompt: Izwi rimwechete rinoonekwa mumamiriro matatu madiki. Verenga mamiriro ega ega uye usarudze zvarinoreva ipapo usati wavona anotevera.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Usati wasarudza, verenga mutsetse uri pamberi pezwi.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti mumwe munhu aita chii: abvunza, atenda kana kukumbira ruregerero?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
Mamiriro 1. 하나 anoratidza shamwari yake ku민수.

하나: 민수 씨, 이 사람은 지우 씨예요.
민수: 지우 씨는 선생님이에요?
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kupindura mubvunzo we yes/no, 아니에요 zvinoreva 'no'.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hapana akamutenda, saka 'hazvina mhosva' haina chikonzero chekutaurwa.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hapana chinodikanwa kukanganwirwa pano; 민수 akabvunza mubvunzo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.info:
Mamiriro 2. Gare gare, 민수 anokweretesa 하나 pen.

하나: 고마워요!
민수: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Mushure me 고마워요, 아니에요 mhinduro inozvininipisa: 'It's nothing.' Izwi rimwechete zvino rinopindura kutenda, kwete mubvunzo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Akabata pen. Izvi zvinoverenga izwi sezvazvaiita muMamiriro 1 uye zvinoramba zvakataurwa na하나.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.info:
Mamiriro 3. Muhoro 민수 anorova ruoko rwa하나.

민수: 죄송해요!
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Mushure mekukumbira ruregerero, 아니에요 zvinoreva 'It's fine, don't worry.' Izwi rimwechete, mabasa matatu: mutsetse uri pamberi ndiwo unosarudza.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hapana chinoratidza mamiriro aya kuti ane kukahadzika naye; mushure mekukumbira ruregerero, izwi rinopa kunyaradza.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.reflect: Kuverenga kwako 아니에요 kwakachinja kubva pamamiriro kuenda kune mamwe here? Wakatarisa chii kusarudza nguva imwe neimwe?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.prompt: Kutarisa shure mumamiriro matatu, chii chakasarudza zvinoreva 아니에요 nguva imwe neimwe?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa zvakaramba zvakafanana nezvakachinja mumamiriro matatu.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa chinhu chakauya pakarepo pamberi pezwi nguva imwe neimwe.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.a: Izwi rakanga rakafanana nguva dzose, saka haringagone kuva ndiro rakachinja zvinoreva.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.b: Mutsetse wakataurwa pakarepo pamberi payo, uye zvakanga zvangoitika.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.c: Varume nevakadzi vose vanoshandisa izwi nenzira dzose nhatu.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.d: Basa iri rinotaura nezvechinyorwa; zvinoreva pano zvinobva pamazwi ari pamberi.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.explain: Izwi harina kuchinja. Zvinoreva zvakabva pamutsetse wapfuura: mubvunzo (no), kutenda (it's nothing) kana kukumbira ruregerero (it's fine).
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.prompt: Shamwari yekirasi inoti '고마워요!' kwauri nokuti wakakweretesa pen. Pindura muKorean (kutaura kwe -요 kune hunhu) uchizvininipisa 'It's nothing'.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira mutsetse waakaona mushure me 고마워요 mumamiriro 2.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.1: Chengeta mugumo une hunhu (-요); mhinduro pfupi yakanaka.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mhinduro yangu inoderedza kukosha kwechipo panzvimbo pokudzokorora kutenda here?

n-k-l1e-04.title: Ndiani mudiki? Kuenzanisa chete
n-k-l1e-04.goal: Shandura kuzvitaura kwenguva dzose kana uchienzanisa zera chete kuita mutemo, vaka seti dzemakore dzakarurama dzakawanda, kwazisa nehunhu neimwe, uye utsvage zvakarurama mune dzose.
n-k-l1e-04.material:
Vanhu vana vanosangana mukirasi yeKorean (vose vakagadzirwa). 민아 anotaura zera rake. Vamwe vanoenzanisa chete.

민아: 저는 20살이에요.
하나: 저는 민아 씨보다 어려요. 지호 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
선생님: 저는 민아 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
(지호 haatauri chinhu pamusoro pezera.)

Mazwi: 어려요 = mudiki (mudiki); 나이가 많아요 = mukuru; A보다 = kupfuura A.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.prompt: Hana anoti: '저는 민아 씨보다 어려요.' Izvi zvinokuudza chii pamusoro paHana?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga 보다 mumutsara uye uone kuti inobatanidza vanhu vaviri vapi.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti pane nhamba ipi zvayo mumutsara wake here.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.a: Hana ane makore 19, saka mudiki negore rimwe kupfuura 민아.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.a: Mutsara unoti 'younger' asi hapana nhamba. 19 imwe chete yemakore mazhinji anogoneka.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.b: Hana mudiki kupfuura 민아; mutsara hapi nhamba.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.c: 어려요 zvinoreva 'mudiki'. -보다 zvinoreva 'than', saka Hana mudiki, kwete mukuru.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.d: Dai vaiva nezera rimwechete, hapana angati '어려요'.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.explain: '-보다 어려요' inoisa kuenzanisa, kwete nhamba. Makore mazhinji anokodzera.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.prompt: Munhu wose mukirasi ari pakati pe10 ne60. 민아 ane 20. Vaka mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana (j = 지호, h = 하나, t = 선생님) umo mutsara wose uri wechokwadi, uye shandisa zera rakasiyana ra하나 pane imwe neimwe.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isa vanhu vana nenhevedzano kubva kumudiki kusvika kumukuru kutanga.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza zera ra하나, wobva wasarudza 지호 mudiki uye 선생님 mukuru.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.2: Tarisa mutsara weKorean mumwe nomumwe nenhamba dzako imwe nemwe.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Hapana mukirasi ari pasi pe10 kana pamusoro pe60.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c2: 하나 anoti mudiki kupfuura 민아, ane 20.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c4: 선생님 anoti mukuru kupfuura 민아, ane 20.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.explain: Mitsara inopa kuenzanisa chete, saka makore mazhinji anokodzera: semuenzaniso 12 < 15 < 20 < 35. Nhamba dzipi neodzipi dziri munhevedzano chaiyo dzinoshanda.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza mumwe wemienzaniso yako. Nyora muKorean zvinotaura 지호 kana achisangana ne선생님 kekutanga: kwaziso ine hunhu nezera rake.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga nekwaziso ine hunhu yaunoziva kubva pazuva rekutanga rekirasi.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Shandisa nhamba yako ya지호 pamwe ne 살 kuzera.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Zera randakanyora rinoenderana nenhamba ya지호 mumuenzaniso wangu here?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.prompt: Chirevo chipi chiri chechokwadi mumienzaniso YOSE yakarurama, kwete wako chete?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mienzaniso yako mitatu padivi nedivi uye uone zvisingachinji.

n-k-l1f-02.title: Makapu mashanu eofisi
n-k-l1f-02.goal: Shandura meseji pfupi kuita mamiriro chaiwo, tsvaga maodha akati wandei anosangana nawo ese, uye uzivise rimwe muchiKorea.
n-k-l1f-02.material:
Shamwari yako inokutumira meseji usati waenda kucafe:

"커피도 주스도 사 와요. 모두 다섯 잔이에요. 돈은 만 삼천 원 있어요."

Mazwi: 커피도 주스도 = zvose kofi nejusi (zvimwe zvechimwe nechimwe); 모두 = pamwe chete; 돈 = mari; 있어요 = une.

n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga maodha 3 akasiyana anokodzera zvese zviri mumeseji. c = makapu ekofi, j = makapu ejusi.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro kutanga nemazwi ako, rimwe pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga ne c = 1 uye utsvage j kuti makapu awedzere kusvika kuhuwandu; wobva waedza c = 2, uye zvichiendera mberi.

n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 모두 다섯 잔이에요: makapu anowedzera kusvika mashanu chaiwo.

n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Nhamba dzangu dzinoenderana neodha rimwe randakagadzira here?

n-k-l1g-01.title: Pano, ipapo, uko: nzvimbo yani?
n-k-l1g-01.goal: Ona kuti 여기 ne거기 zvinoratidza nzvimbo yani, ona kuti nei zvinyorwa ne여기 zvinogona kurasisa muverengi, uzvinyore patsva nezita chairo renzvimbo.
n-k-l1g-01.material:
'Mina naJun shamwari. Mushure mekirasi vanoda kusangana, asi vari panzvimbo dzakasiyana. Mina ari pamberi pechikoro (학교 앞). Jun ari pamberi pelaibhurari (도서관 앞). Vari kutaura nerunhare.

민아: 준, 지금 어디예요?
준: 저는 도서관 앞이에요. 민아는요?
민아: 저는 학교 앞이에요.
준: 거기에서 기다려요. 제가 가요.'

n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.r.c: 여기 yemeseji haimbosuruvara nzvimbo yemuverengi; kunzvimbo yemuverengi Mina aizonyora 거기.

n-k-l1g-02.title: Ofisi yeposvo inowirirana nani?
n-k-l1g-02.topic: Nzvimbo dziri muguta: 옆, 왼쪽, 오른쪽
n-k-l1g-02.goal: Tarisa nzira yakanyorwa nemepu, tsvaga mitsara isingaenderani, nzwisisa zvinotaurwa chaizvo ne옆, uye uruamise mutsara mumwe.

n-k-l1h-03.title: Unogona kuva kumuvhi pa1 o'clock here?
n-k-l1h-03.goal: Sarudza zvokwadi zvipi zvevhiki yako zvaunoda usati wapindura kukoka kweshamwari, cherekedza kuti zvokwadi zviviri zvinofanira kubatanidzwa, uye upindure muKorean.

Shamwari yako Jina inokutumira meseji.

지나: 토요일 한 시에 영화를 봐요. 같이 가요?

Unotarisa vhiki yako. Izvi ndizvo zvaunoziva:

- 토요일 수업이 오전 아홉 시에 시작해요.
- 토요일 수업이 열두 시에 끝나요.
- 학교에서 영화관까지 삼십 분 걸려요.
- 일요일 저녁에 가족 식사가 있어요.
- 월요일부터 금요일까지 회사에 가요.
n-k-l1h-03.thinking.1: Kubatanidza zvokwadi zviviri (nguva yekupera + nguva yerwendo)
n-k-l1h-03.prereq.1: Unoziva mazuva evhiki nenguva dzewachi (열두 시, 한 시)

n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira uri kuchikoro kirasi ichipera. Zvinhu zviviri zvipi zvaunoda kuziva kuti utaure kuti unosvika rinhi?

n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.r.d: Sunday izuva rimwe. Haribatsiri Saturday pa1.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.r.e: Monday kusvika Friday mazuva mamwe. Haabatsiri Saturday.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.explain: Unoda nguva yaunosununguka (kirasi inopera pa12:00) nenguva yaunoda kusvika ikoko (maminetsi 30). Nechimwe chete hauzogoni kusarudza. Zvimwe zvokwadi zvitatu zvechokwadi, asi zvinotaura nezvenguva dzimwe.

n-k-l1h-05.title: Nguva yeboka rekudzidza
n-k-l1h-05.goal: Shandura meseji pfupi ina dzeshamwari kuita mamiriro chaiwo, tsvaga sarudzo 3 dzakasiyana dzezuva nenguva dzinogutsa dzose, uye unyore chirongwa muKorean.
n-k-l1h-05.material:
Shamwari ina dzinosangana kamwe pavhiki kudzidza Korean. Vanodzidza masikati kwemaawa maviri.

민호: 월요일하고 금요일에는 일해요.
지아: 토요일 오전에는 수영해요. 일요일에는 안 와요.
수아: 오후 세 시 전에는 안 돼요. 여섯 시에는 집에 가요.
유나: 수요일 오후 네 시에 한국어 수업이 있어요.

(Monday = 월요일, Tuesday = 화요일, Wednesday = 수요일, Thursday = 목요일, Friday = 금요일, Saturday = 토요일, Sunday = 일요일)
(안 와요 = haauyi, 안 돼요 = hazvigoneki, 전 = pamberi)
